summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressReaderContext classes, _file_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file with overloads, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods); tests/test_progress.py (20 new tests); docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased/Added bullet for PR 1759). The diff is additive only. Nothing was committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, per instructions, so verification was by reading only. Choices made: DownloadColumn as the byte-count column; io.open used inside progress.py to avoid the shadowed builtin; the module-level implementation takes mode as Any so the overloaded Progress.open type-checks; the context wrapper subclasses AbstractContextManager with __enter__ returning Any, avoiding extra suppressions. Suppressions are limited to the spec-listed readline override, readinto no-untyped-def/override, and handle readinto attr-defined. The readinto ignore codes may need adjusting once mypy runs.
